_notes:
Hand-authored bag catalog - the exception to this project's usual procedural-item rule (see LootGenerator). Bags are a small, fixed, named set, not something that benefits from procedural stat rolls the way armor/weapons do - a bag's only stat is bag_capacity. slot is the generic 'bag' PAIRED_SLOTS key (entities/equipment.py) so any of these fills whichever of bag1-bag4 is open, same convention as 'ring'/'trinket'. icon_id points at assets/icons/bags/<icon_id>.png (IconRenderer.BAG_ICON_DIR) - real WoW Classic icon art (Kyle's 'WoW Vanilla/Classic Icon Pack' upload, INV_Misc_Bag_* series), replacing an earlier hand-cropped fan-art sheet. Capacity/rarity/required_level tiered low-to-high roughly matching WoW's own bag progression, assigned by each icon's visual grandeur - plain sacks read as starter tier, the rune-etched/locked ones read as top tier.

Extended above level 30 on 5 Nov 2026. The ladder stopped at a single level-30 epic, so every vendor in a 44-49 zone could only ever roll that one bag - qa_vendors reported five of them as 'every bag roll returns the same item'. Added in PAIRS at 34/38/42/46 (22/24/26/28 capacity) because the failure was variety, not ceiling: one bag per step would have raised the cap and still read as a vending machine. Pricing continues the catalog's own curve (4g at 16 slots, 8g at 18, 15g at 20) with the growth tapered - doubling every four levels from 30 would have put the best bag past 200g, which this economy does not support; Kyle's level-12 friend had 2.5g. sell_price is vendor/5 throughout, matching every existing entry. All eight icons were checked against assets/icons/bags before being named.
